verdicts.proof: Old 70a94933 all_pois_screen.dart:548-554 shows the banner when q.isNotEmpty && routeHits > 0 and pushes Routes.routesList. Current all_pois_screen.dart:540-543 (v2 branch, starts at :484) uses the same condition and onTap context.push(Routes.routesList); routeHits is counted once above the branch (:463-470). PlacesRoutesBannerV2 (v2/places_parts_v2.dart:241-270) is a tappable card with a route icon and the label 'searchAlsoRoutes · n'. This is the only v2 entry.

Old :589-595 shows _empty() when list.isEmpty. Current :544-545 has the same list.isEmpty branch in v2. _empty() at :2269-2276 returns TrasyEmptyV2 with a map icon, the 'poiEmpty' title and a 'routesFilterClear' action when _allFilterCount > 0. The list is computed by the shared _filtered() above the branch.

Old card: long-press calls _toggleSel and tap calls _openPoiDetail (:2015/:2021 in the current old branch). v2 PlaceCardV2 (all_pois_screen.dart:1995-2008) gets onTap=_openPoiDetail and onToggle=_toggleSel. place_card_v2.dart:126-127 sets MgPress onTap: onTap and onLongPress: onToggle; _ToggleDisc at :210 calls onToggle. The map preview's onPlaceTap calls _toggleSel (:838) and is shared by both looks. Selection is shown by a neon border and the stop order badge (place_card_v2.dart:113-116, :144-170).

_mapPreview (:820-846) builds one PlacesMapView with allowDrag:false, onMapTap -> placesMap, onPlaceTap -> _toggleSel, onPlaceLongPress -> _openPoiDetail and onLongPress -> PoiSubmitScreen. In v2 (:848-849) that same widget goes into PlacesMapCardV2 (places_parts_v2.dart:82-131), which only wraps it in MapTileErrorInset and adds an expand button (onExpand = placesMap). The 'placesMapOpenHint' text now has a finger icon. The old look also explained the gestures only in small text, so v2 is the same.

Old :532-538 shows the location prompt and map preview only when widget.asTab && !widget.pickMode. v2 :485 sets hub = widget.asTab && !widget.pickMode, and :534-535 renders the prompt and preview only when hub is true. Route-builder pick mode is AllPoisScreen(pickMode:true) (route_builder_screen.dart:144). /pois is AllPoisScreen(initialSelected:) with asTab false (router.dart:314). Only the tab route has asTab:true (router.dart:527). Silent in both looks, which is intended because nothing is refused.

Old community_submit.dart:27-49 (70a94933) offers the start/stop row only when !auto. Current community_submit.dart:41-85 keeps the same if (!auto) row (the pause row is added in both looks). The menu is reached from all_pois_screen.dart:504, routes_list_parts_v2.dart:35, moje_view_v2.dart:179 and routes_screen.dart:318. New v2 entry: the Places dock TrasyRecordDockV2 (all_pois_screen.dart:563-565). In record_dock_v2.dart:55-103, live = showRecord && rec.recording. The idle 'Zaznamenat jízdu' CTA (:88-101) exists only when the dock is not live, so it is hidden during any recording, automatic rental ones included. In selection mode the record disc appears only when showRecord && !live (:60, :146) and never in pick mode. While recording, stop is offered only when rec.canStop (= recording && manual, ride_recorder_state.dart:73): rec_live_bar_v2.dart:86 and record_dock_v2.dart:66. Stop also asks for confirmation first (trasyConfirmStopRide, ride_pause_actions_v2.dart:93-97). Start goes through toggleManualRide -> startManualResult with a result sheet (ride_actions.dart:16-46). I did not trace deeper recorder guards (permissions, offline) here; they belong to the recording bucket.

All v2 '+' buttons call the same showCommunityAddMenu: all_pois_screen.dart:504 (hub only), routes_list_parts_v2.dart:35 and moje_view_v2.dart:179. The menu has no look branch for its items and keeps the login checks (currentUser == null -> snackbar 'poiRateLogin') at community_submit.dart:88 and :96 before RouteSubmitScreen / PoiSubmitScreen. The block shows as a snackbar in both looks. The map long-press path to PoiSubmitScreen (:841-843) is shared and unchanged from old.

v2 :487-494: sel is null when _selected.length == 0. For the non-hub screen, dock = sel == null ? null : TrasyRecordDockV2(showRecord:false) (:565), so there is no button until something is selected. onContinue calls the same _navigate (:2252-2259), which returns when pois is empty and pops with pois in pickMode. The dock label is v2RtSelAdd when pick is true (record_dock_v2.dart:144), and there is no record disc when pick is set (:146). route_builder_screen.dart:146 ignores null or empty. The system back / header back pops null (:507).

_localSel = pickMode || initialSelected != null (:107). _f, _setFilter, _selected, _toggleSel and _clearSel (:93-125) use local state when _localSel is set. The placesSearchProvider listener returns early when _localSel (:415), and shared falls back to the local query (:420). All of this runs in build before the MgV2.on branch at :484, so both looks use it. Silent by design.

v2 header (:497-511): onSegment, onMap and onAdd are set only when hub (= asTab && !pickMode). TrasyHubHeaderV2 hides segments, map and add when they are null (trasy_hub_header_v2.dart:89, :129, :135, :157). onBack in pickMode is Navigator.pop() (:507), with a back arrow and the title poiBrowseAll. The map preview and location prompt are hub-only (:534-535). The dock has no record control for non-hub (:565).

router.dart:310-315 builds AllPoisScreen(initialSelected: ids) wrapped in MgBackGuard. MgBackGuard (core/widgets/mg_back.dart:101-131) only routes the system back. initState preloads _own from initialSelected (all_pois_screen.dart:172-174), and _localSel is true. v2 non-hub dock (:565) appears only while the selection is non-empty, and its 'Continue' action goes through the same _navigate (:2252). The old router (70a94933 router.dart:270-274) had the same screen without the back guard.

route_poi_sheet.dart:177 renders the trip button only if widget.onToggleSelect != null, the same as old :173-185. The v2 look is chosen at :548 (PoiTripButtonV2, poi_sheet_v2.dart:84-110: a filled CTA 'poiAddToTrip', or an outline button with a check and 'poiRemoveFromTrip'). Callers that pass onToggleSelect are only all_pois_screen.dart:925, places_map_screen.dart:242 and routes_map_screen.dart:118; routes_map passed it in old as well (70a94933 :107). Route detail, navigation, poi_suggest and my_experiences do not pass it.

_PoiPagerState (route_poi_sheet.dart:104-150) is byte-identical in logic to old: _go returns at the bounds (:116-117), and drag handlers are attached only when many (:139-150). siblingWindow radius 150 is in places_filter.dart:907 and is unchanged from old, and all_pois_screen.dart:912 applies it. The counter appears only when many, as PoiSheetCounterV2 'n / m' (:206-207). v2 adds a visible close button (:196) but does not change paging.
